numberAttrs.html:
1. Welcome to OpenOffice

A Word-compatible editor for the web

This document behaves like Microsoft Word: use the Ribbon above to format text, insert tables and pictures, and lay out pages. Everything here works — try it.

Getting started

Select some text and apply a Style from the Home tab, or make it italic, underlined, struck through, or add a color. You can also use highlighting, super/subscripts like E = mc2 and H2O, and change fonts and sizes from the Font group.

  • Bulleted and numbered lists

  • Tables, images, and links

  • Page layout, margins, orientation, and columns

Save your work

Open the File tab to create, open, save, and print documents. Saving writes a real .docx file you can open in Microsoft Word.

"The best way to predict the future is to invent it." — Alan Kay

Press Ctrl+F to find and replace, or Ctrl+S to save.
